scenes.narration: Intro. Certification. In this video we review 8 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: How many questions are typically on an AEM Sites Developer Expert certification exam?
scenes.heading: 50 questions
scenes.body: The AEM Sites Developer Expert certification exam consists of 50 questions (multiple choice and multiple select format), with a 100-minute duration and approximately 70% passing score.

scenes.question: Which exam domain carries the highest weight in the AEM Sites Developer Expert certification?
scenes.heading: Development (44%)
scenes.body: The Development domain carries the highest weight at approximately 44% of the exam. It covers component development with HTL and Sling Models, editable templates, Content/Experience Fragments, workflows, services, MSM, and more.

scenes.question: What percentage of the AEM certification exam covers Configuration topics?
scenes.body: Configuration is Domain 1 and covers approximately 22% of the exam. Topics include OSGi configuration and services, run modes, project structure (ui.apps, ui.content, core), Maven build configuration, and Dispatcher farm configurations.

scenes.question: What does 'Domain 3: Build and Deployment' in the AEM certification cover?
scenes.heading: Maven builds, CI/CD pipelines, Cloud Manager, and deployment strategies
scenes.body: Domain 3 (Build and Deployment, ~14%) covers Maven build lifecycle and plugins, content packages, Package Manager, CI/CD pipelines in Cloud Manager, code quality gates, SonarQube, and deployment strategies including rollback.

scenes.question: What is the recommended daily study time for the AEM certification preparation?
scenes.heading: 1–2 hours daily, with consistency over cramming
scenes.body: Best practice for AEM certification preparation is 1-2 hours of consistent daily study over 3-6 months. Consistency beats cramming — active learning (building examples, not just reading) is more effective than passive review.

scenes.question: What is the Pomodoro technique as it applies to AEM certification study?
scenes.heading: 25 minutes of focused study followed by a 5-minute break
scenes.body: The Pomodoro technique is a time management method that uses 25-minute focused work intervals separated by 5-minute breaks. It's recommended for AEM study to maintain concentration and prevent burnout during long study sessions.

scenes.question: What is the WKND Tutorial in the context of AEM development?
scenes.heading: Adobe's official hands-on tutorial project for learning AEM, building a sample site
scenes.body: WKND is Adobe's official multi-part tutorial for learning AEM by building a complete Sites project from scratch. It covers the entire development workflow — project structure, components, templates, Sling Models, clientlibs, and deployment — and is the recommended starting point for new AEM developers.
